plain_metadata_checks: five finite identity/selector assertions; not scientific runtime tests

bbox.observed_bbox_status: No explicit workpiece bounding-box/xmax scalar in the inspected model or geometry descriptors.

This bound is proved from source rules and descriptor grid, not measured from NPZ or a newly reconstructed cell cohort.
limitations: No bound on deformed right-edge coordinates, medium clearance, J, or reaction sensitivity.
Actual saved staircase xmax not observed; no 3mm nominal margin treated as approved travel.

right_boundary.right_upper_endpoint_uy: Zero uy via y=40 background symmetry on [0,92].
right_boundary.other_right_edge_dofs: No separate right-edge fixed set is created by native_project; support at x0 and workpiece below x89.25 are disjoint from x92.
right_boundary.explicit_right_external_traction: Not declared by the inspected native task schema.
right_boundary.variational_boundary_warning: No imposed wall does not mean an infinite medium or simply P*n=0: the original full material plus Hu weak residual and its natural boundary effects remain.

recommendation.body_motion: All original body incident nodes ux=q, uy=0; theta_z=0; no re-rasterization and no independent unlocked body-node displacements.
recommendation.q_candidate_status: Proposed first tiny nonzero target, not executed and not a newly authorized real solve.
recommendation.load_control: Prescribe q; infer required drive reaction. Do not prescribe axial external force simultaneously.
recommendation.other_actuator: The gripper mean-displacement actuator remains a separate reaction at fixed input1.06.
recommendation.force_control_later: Unknown common rigid q and specified half external load; require generalized equilibrium and separate displacement/capacity interpretation.

force_convention.units: N with t20mm already integrated; do not multiply by20 again
force_convention.half_required_drive: Q_drive_half = sum_B(f_internal_x_total) = -F_on_x_half, only when no independent axial body load is applied
force_convention.half_to_full: Same common q in both halves. Q_drive_full=2*Q_drive_half. Given P_full, apply P_half=P_full/2 exactly once.
force_convention.guide: Constrained uy and rotation can produce guide forces/moments. Report them; symmetry cancellation is not proof of unconstrained bearing.
force_convention.sign: Positive Q_drive is the +x drive required to resist an opposite -x model force. Negative values must remain signed and are not clamped.
force_convention.decomposition: Retain total/material/Hu as model weak-force components, not pressure or Coulomb friction.

Finite gamma and Hu couple right medium to reaction; preserve decomposition.
